newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-STEAUA SURPRISE GROUP LEADERS ATLETICO MADRID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEAUA SURPRISE GROUP LEADERS ATLETICO MADRID.

text.p: Strugglers Steaua Bucharest came from behind to snatch an unexpected 1-1 draw against group B leaders Atletico Madrid in their European Cup Champions' League match on Wednesday.

Forward Sabin Ilie scored six minutes after the break -- Steaua's first genuine goal in five league matches. Defender Daniel Bogusz of Poland's Widzew Lodz had contributed an own goal for the Romanians' benefit in an earlier match.

The Madrid side had seized the lead in the 23rd minute. Francisco Narvaez sent a perfect cross from the right side and Serb playmaker Milinko Pantic scored from an unmarked close-range position into an empty net.
Atletico are level on 10 points with Germany's Borussia Dortmund while Steau are bottom of the group and have no chance of reaching the quarter-finals.
